urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to screenshot. One screenshot per URL. Only http:// and https:// URLs are accepted.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of only the visible viewport.

device.title: Device
device.description: Desktop uses the viewport size below. Mobile emulates an iPhone 13 and tablet an iPad (7th gen), including user agent and pixel ratio.

viewportWidth.title: Viewport width (px)
viewportWidth.description: Browser window width for the desktop device.

viewportHeight.title: Viewport height (px)
viewportHeight.description: Browser window height for the desktop device. With Full page on, it only affects how the page lays out.

format.title: Image format
format.description: PNG is lossless; JPEG files are much smaller.

jpegQuality.title: JPEG quality
jpegQuality.description: From 1 to 100. Used only when the format is JPEG.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners
hideCookieBanners.description: Hide the consent banners of common cookie frameworks (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi, Usercentrics and others) with CSS. Nothing is clicked or accepted.

hideSelectors.title: Extra CSS selectors to hide
hideSelectors.description: Any other elements to hide before the screenshot, such as chat widgets or popups.

scrollToBottom.title: Scroll to load lazy images
scrollToBottom.description: Before a full-page screenshot, scroll through the page so lazy-loaded images appear.

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: How long to wait for the page before the capture. The DOM is always awaited; 'Page load' and 'Network idle' get up to 30 extra seconds, and pages that never finish loading (common on ad-heavy sites) are captured as they are instead of failing.

waitForSelector.title: Wait for selector
waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector that must appear before the screenshot is taken.

delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Extra time to wait right before the screenshot, for animations.

timeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Maximum time to load each page. Pages that take longer are reported as failed and are not charged.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to screenshot in parallel.
